structured.feedback: The copy invents product claims not in the source (e.g., "glides on with precision," "formula is designed to hold its shape," "wear it under your favorite lipstick"), which overpromises. It also never clearly separates features from benefits as the prompt requires, and it leans on generic phrasing like "practical addition to any beauty collection."
